title: Global Challenge for Safe and Secure LLMs Track 1

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of automated jailbreaking methods (e.g., SI-GCG, Equivalent Substitution) designed to bypass model safeguards and elicit predefined undesirable behaviors, including prejudice and offensive language.

Calculating log-perplexity differentials of harmful instructions within queries versus completions to identify skewed data distributions (scarcity of harmful examples) introduced during safety fine-tuning.
